Alex — thanks for the context and the attachments. We can support a split between ACH (US) and SEPA/wire (EU) but need to confirm a couple of items to lock the timelines:

- ACH timing: standard ACH credit from your bank typically posts to our bank in 1–2 business days; with same-day ACH it's possible to get funds on the same day but requires both banks to support same-day and the payment to be submitted early in the day.
- Cutover window: if you need funds available by next Friday (2028-09-08), the latest we can accept ACH to reasonably guarantee availability is EOD Wednesday 2028-09-06 (PST) — earlier is safer.
- EU wire: once we confirm beneficiary details, wires typically clear in 1 business day but may be 2 depending on intermediary banks and currency routing.

Can you confirm: the origin bank (for ACH) and whether they support same-day ACH? Also please confirm the exact split (you mentioned 70/30). Once confirmed I’ll loop in finance to pre-authorize the entity split and provide the target account details for the EU wire.

Cc’ing Ben (finance ops) to provide the receiving-bank details and to call out any fees or routing constraints. Laura — I’ll need your help if procurement wants a mutual action plan in HubSpot.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

2) EU routing — for the 30% EU portion we can accept a SEPA credit to our EU entity (Redwood EU Ltd). Beneficiary and IBAN are in our internal wire form (I attached below as a stub). 3) Fees / FX — there are no incoming bank fees charged by Redwood; intermediary bank fees may apply for cross-border wires. If you hit any intermediary fees we can discuss crediting them depending on the deal.
